g.text: HBM (exam!): action needs SUSCEPTIBILITY ("me too!") + SEVERITY ("bad!") + BENEFITS
(outweigh!) − BARRIERS (shrunk!) + CUE (trigger!) + SELF-EFFICACY ("I CAN!"). Diagnose the
MISSING belief: no fear? show risk. Fear frozen? shrink barriers + boost can-do.
STAGES (Prochaska — exam!): PREcontemplation ("no need" → raise doubt, don't preach!) ·
CONTEMPLation ("maybe…" → tip decisional balance!) · PREParation ("soon!" → plan!) ·
ACTION ("doing!" → support + praise!) · MAINTENANCE ("keeping!" → relapse plan!) ·
RELAPSE ("slipped!" → normalise + restart kindly!). Match talk to stage!
MISMATCH HARMS: action-plans for precontemplators ("here's a diet sheet!" → bin!) · doubt-
raising for actors ("are you SURE…?" → undermines!). Stage FIRST ("where are you…?"),
then match. Ruler: "ready 0–10…? why not lower…?" (their reasons = change talk!).
SELF-EFFICACY (Bandura!): "I CAN" predicts doing. Build: small wins ("one walk!") · models
("market women like you did it!") · praise effort ("you came — strong start!") · skills
(demos! teach-back!). Efficacy beats fear — scared + helpless = frozen.
RELAPSE = DATA: "what triggered…? what worked before…? restart which piece…?" — lapse
(slip!) vs relapse (slide!) vs collapse (give-up!) — rescue at lapse, always kindly.
CUES: pill + toothbrush · clinic + market day · walks + radio news · reviews + paydays.
Anchor new habits to old routines — memory outsourced, adherence inbuilt.
LINKS: NUT one-change · COM miracle/scales · M06 MI spirit.
MANTRA: "stage it, match it, shrink barriers, grow can-do."
